newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Ingosstrakh, Novosibirsk sign agreement.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Ingosstrakh, Novosibirsk sign agreement.

text.p: Russia's second biggest insurance company SAO Ingosstrakh and Novosibirsk region signed an agreement on Monday to promote insurance operations in the region as part of Ingosstrakh's efforts to diversify into new areas such as medical insurance.
"This is one more step in setting up stable financial conditions in the region," Novosibirsk region governor Vitaly Mukha said at the signing ceremony.
The one-year agreement provides for help from the regional authorities to Ingosstrakh in promoting its services in the region, Ingosstrakh vice-president Fyodor Prokopov said.
Operations in the region would be a top priority, it said in a statement.
Ingosstrakh, which mainly specialises in corporate insurance abroad, plans to promote medical insurance for individuals as part of the agreement, Prokopov said.
"Ingosstrakh plans to enter the market for voluntary medical insurance seriously," he said.
He said Ingosstrakh, unlike other Russian insurance companies, would offer medical care in hospitals abroad without charging extra fees.
Ingosstrakh will soon sign similar agreements with other Russian regions, president Vladimir Kruglyak said.
